'''BigJediJer Death Star Demolition Team''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[BigJediJer]]
* '''Published:''' 19 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat SYCFA BigJediJer DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck can be set to blow up Alderaan, get some good drains at systems and in general cause some major havoc across the galaxy.  It is lacking in systems, so it does rely on the opponent for system drains.

== Strategy ==

Theoreticaly, this deck should be able to blow up Alderaan on the 4th turn. Turn one -deploy phase, pull a gunner from reserve if none in hand, otherwise pull a DS site. Turn two - control phase send gunner to Used pile and get Superlaser. deploy superlaser and pull another DS Gunner or Site.  move DS system to parsec 1.  Turn three - pull DS gunner and Commence Primary ignition, move DS to Alderaan. Turn four - Fire that Superlaser!! Move the DS to Yavin 4 and Hoth and blow them up as well using A million voices to pull Commence Primary Ignition from lost pile.  As far as all the starfighters go, they should be able to stick around for awhile with Fighters Coming in giving all the TIE's in this deck immunity, (Baron Fel in Saber 1 becomes better than Vader in his TIE!) Overwhelmed and Dark Maneuvers will help diminish the opponents fleet.  If you need an extra power boost, All power to weapons can be thrown down, along with the Dreadnaught, all TIEs are power +3.  Come here you big coward will cancel opponents force drains at DS sites early in the game as only the DB is a battleground, and Put all sections on alert will put a stop to all the EPP extra destiny draws and permanant weapons.  Once you flip the objective, start deploying the star destroyers for cheap, and send them out to drain across the galaxy with the TIEs flying cover.
